anyOf.description: Show a message box and wait for confirm.

face.description: A face beside the text: a face sheet is one row of square faces (its height is their size), and index picks one, from 0 on the left.

anyOf.description: Let the player pick one option.

cancel.description: Option index taken when the player cancels. Omit to disallow cancel.

anyOf.description: One of this event's own flags, e.g. a chest's "opened".
A key (an input action) is held down.
The player or an event faces a direction.
A party member has a state (or not). Actors outside the party have none.
A party member's level, HP or MP (or HP/MP as a percent of the most). Actors outside the party count as 0.
An actor's name is this (as changed by events).
Turn one of an event's own flags on or off (kept in saves).
A random whole number from min to max (v9).
A party member’s stat (0 outside the party).
Where the player or an event stands.
Move the player to another map or tile.
Negative amounts take gold away.
Negative amounts take items away.
Move a party member to a place in the party’s order (v11).
Full HP/MP and clear states (e.g. an inn).
Fight a troop, then branch on the outcome.

background.description: Path relative to the project root, using "/" separators.

anyOf.description: Path relative to the project root, using "/" separators.

path.description: Path relative to the project root, using "/" separators.

anyOf.description: Walk the player or an event along a route.
Walk one tile.

direction.description: forward: the way the character faces; backward: away from it, still facing it; the four diagonals move one tile both ways (v9); the player ones are worked out at the time.

anyOf.description: Face a direction without moving.
Stand still.
Walk faster or slower from here on.
Jump to a tile nearby, or on the spot (0, 0) (v9).

x.description: Tiles to the right (left if negative).

anyOf.description: Look like another character from here on (v9).
Walk through walls and characters, or stop doing so (v9).
Keep facing one way while moving and turning, or stop (v9).
Animate the legs while walking (on by default) (v9).
Keep stepping in place even when standing (v9).
Become invisible (still there), or visible again (v9).
Play a sound (v9).

path.description: Path relative to the project root, using "/" separators.

anyOf.description: Turn a switch on or off (v9).
Open a shop to buy (and sell) goods.
Fade the screen to black (out) or back (in). It stays black until faded in.
Tint the screen a colour (e.g. dusk), until tinted again. Kept in saves.
Flash the screen a colour, fading away.
Shake the screen side to side.

power.description: How far it shakes, in pixels.

anyOf.description: Hide an event (as if it had no page) or show it again, until the map loads again.
Hide the player (they are still there and can move) or show them again (v9).
Give an actor another character or name for the rest of the game, in or out of the party (v9).
Put an event on a tile at once (until the map loads again). A spot outside the map is ignored (v9).
Move the view away from the player (the edges of the map still stop it), or back. Until the map changes (v9).
End the game: the game over screen (v9).
End the game and go back to the title (v9).
Let the player save (even if saving is off). The save starts after this event, as if it had finished (v9).
Allow or stop opening the menu, or saving from it. Kept in saves (v9).
Change the music of battles or of winning one. Kept in saves (v9).
Path relative to the project root, using "/" separators.
Change the picture behind battles for the rest of the game. Kept in saves (v11).
Path relative to the project root, using "/" separators.
Change the colour of the game’s windows for the rest of the game. Kept in saves (v12).
A colour, #rrggbb.
A sound that loops beside the music (rain, wind, a crowd) (v9).
Path relative to the project root, using "/" separators.
Give or take HP (negative takes) from one member or everyone (v9).
Give or take MP (negative takes) from one member or everyone (v9).
Add or remove a state for one member or everyone (v9).
Show an image over the map at a screen position (replacing the picture with that number). Pictures stay across maps and in saves until erased (v9).

image.description: Path relative to the project root, using "/" separators.

anyOf.description: Move, resize or fade a picture over time (v9).
Play an animation on the player or an event (v9).
Show a balloon (!, ?, a heart…) over the player or an event (v9).
Take a picture away (v9).
Repeat these commands until a Break loop (or Exit event) inside them.
Leave the loop this is in.
Stop the event here (also from inside a common event it called).
Run a common event’s commands, then carry on here.
Run a command a plugin adds (v10). Arguments left out take their declared defaults.
